# Quickstart: Validate `dist` Generated by Build

**Feature**: `001-build-generated-dist` | **Date**: 2026-08-10

Runnable checks that the invariants hold. Implementation details live in tasks/code; this is the validation guide.

## Prerequisites

- Node per `.nvmrc` / `package.json` engines  
- Clean clone or working tree with dependencies: `npm ci`  
- Contracts: [build-command](./contracts/build-command.md), [asset-manifest](./contracts/asset-manifest.md), [verify-gate](./contracts/verify-gate.md)

## Scenario A — Clone → build → loadable tree (SC-001, FR-003)

```bash
rm -rf dist
npm ci
npm run build
test -f dist/manifest.json
```

**Expect**: `dist/` exists; required scripts/icons/service worker paths from the manifest are present; extension can be loaded unpacked from `dist/` in Chromium.

## Scenario B — Dirty tree becomes clean (FR-004a, SC-002)

```bash
npm run build
mkdir -p dist/js
echo orphan > dist/js/__orphan_probe__.js
npm run build
test ! -f dist/js/__orphan_probe__.js
npm run audit:dist
```

**Expect**: Probe file gone after official build; audit reports zero files without source.

## Scenario C — Bit-identity (FR-004b, SC-002a)

```bash
rm -rf dist dist-a dist-b
npm run build && cp -a dist dist-a
rm -rf dist
npm run build && cp -a dist dist-b
diff -rq dist-a dist-b
```

**Expect**: `diff -rq` produces no output (trees identical). After the feature’s gate lands, the structure test covering G6 should encode this without manual copies.

## Scenario D — Not versioned (FR-002, SC-003)

```bash
git ls-files dist
git check-ignore -q --no-index dist/manifest.json && echo ignored
```

**Expect**: `git ls-files dist` empty; ignore rule hits a sample path under `dist/`.

## Scenario E — Full portão (FR-007, SC-004)

```bash
npm run verify
```

**Expect**: typecheck, lint, tests (including structure gates), and dist audit all pass.

### Negative probes (should fail)

```bash
# orphan
echo x > dist/js/__should_fail_audit__.js
npm run audit:dist   # expect non-zero / SEM FONTE

# cleanup before continuing
rm -f dist/js/__should_fail_audit__.js
```

## Scenario F — Onboarding path (FR-006, SC-006)

Follow only `DEVELOPMENT.md` (or README build section): install → build → load unpacked.  
**Expect**: No instruction to commit or hand-edit `dist/`; build is mandatory after clone.

## Slice rule (FR-010, SC-008)

After each implementation slice of this feature: re-run Scenarios A and E before merge. Do not merge a slice that leaves official build unable to produce a loadable `dist/`.
